txnStart.description: Timestamp when the transaction was started.

connStart.description: Timestamp when the connection holding the transaction was started.

state.description: Current state of the transaction (Postgres defined).

queryStart.description: Timestamp when the last query in the transaction was started.

query.description: Last query executed for the transaction.

clientAddr.description: Client ip address of txn owner.

clientHostname.description: Client host name of txn owner.
